company.name: BotCity
company.shortDescription: BotCity is a governance and orchestration platform for Python scripts created by AI or humans.
company.description:
BotCity is a governance platform for Python scripts created by AI or humans.

AI copilots have turned Python into the new Excel macro. Business users are now generating thousands of scripts with GPT to automate workflows, often outside IT’s control. This wave of shadow automation creates serious risks to security, compliance, and continuity.

BotCity brings oversight and governance to this new wave of AI-generated automation. We are YC-backed, growing 3x annually, serving enterprise customers such as Bayer and LG.
